title: STEM Without Barriers: Empowering Persons Living With Disabilities Through Inclusive Skills for the Future
description: This special on-demand Career Café course embodies our unwavering commitment to equity, inclusion, and opportunity for all. STEM Without Barriers equips learners living with disabilities with practical, accessible, future-ready skills to thrive in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics.
content:
Learning Outcomes:

  • Enhance foundational STEM competencies through accessible, disability-inclusive teaching tools and practices.
  • Build digital and technical skills required for emerging STEM career pathways, including AI, data science, and innovation.
  • Strengthen self-advocacy and career readiness, enabling learners to navigate workplace environments confidently and assert their needs.
  • Promote inclusive leadership and problem-solving, empowering participants to contribute to STEM advancement and champion accessibility in their fields.

title: Global Public Health Entrepreneurship and Leadership
description: This dynamic on-demand course bridges public health, innovation, and entrepreneurship. It equips professionals to identify opportunities, design scalable health solutions, and lead with integrity in resource-constrained settings.
content:
Learning Outcomes:

  • Understand how entrepreneurship can drive sustainable public health solutions.
  • Learn leadership principles for managing complex health systems.
  • Develop innovative business models for public health challenges.
  • Strengthen strategic thinking, resource mobilization, and collaboration skills.

title: Youth Reimagined: Thinking Differently, Learning Boldly, and Leading with Confidence
description: Designed for forward-thinking youth, this course helps participants cultivate critical thinking, creativity, and confidence to thrive in uncertain times. Learners will discover new ways of learning, unlearn limiting beliefs, and build skills for digital and real-world success.
content:
Learning Outcomes:

  • Develop critical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Build confidence to lead and take initiative in any environment.
  • Explore modern, experiential ways of learning and growing.
  • Cultivate adaptability and a future-focused mindset in the digital era.

title: Women in Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM): Innovation, Entrepreneurship, and Leadership for Change
description: This on-demand course equips women in STEM with the skills, mindset, and confidence to lead innovation and entrepreneurial ventures that create real impact. Participants will explore leadership strategies, gender equity dynamics, and tools to translate scientific ideas into scalable solutions.
content:
Learning Outcomes:

  • Build entrepreneurial and leadership skills tailored to women in STEM.
  • Learn strategies to navigate gender barriers and lead inclusively.
  • Transform scientific and technical ideas into viable innovations.
  • Strengthen professional networks and mentorship pathways.
